title: Product Delivery
summary: Explicitly activated provider-neutral product-to-delivery workflow with two exact user approval gates.

roles.title: Product Partner
roles.summary: Discovery and product alignment partner. Use to turn a broad idea into a testable Product Brief, to review a Delivery Plan against an approved brief, and to request exact user approval of either artifact.

roles.title: Delivery Lead
roles.summary: Repository-aware technical owner and execution lead. Use to investigate the real codebase, produce an implementation-ready Delivery Plan from an approved Product Brief, execute approved work, and report implementation results.

roles.title: Verifier
roles.summary: Independent evidence-oriented reviewer. Use proactively after execution to check the actual changes against the approved Product Brief and Delivery Plan, and to report passed, failed, unverified, and skipped checks with evidence.
